name: BeamMP
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The multiplayer server for BeamNG.drive, through the BeamMP mod. Needs an AuthKey from BeamMP's Keymaster; Lua plugins go in Resources/Server and mods in Resources/Client.
startup: ./BeamMP-Server | while IFS= read -r l; do printf "%s\n" "$l"; case "$l" in *"[INFO] Shutdown.") kill 0 ;; esac; done

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# BeamMP. Downloads the BeamMP server for the node's CPU from GitHub and
# checks it against GitHub's checksum. ServerConfig.toml, Resources (mods
# and Lua plugins) are never touched once they exist.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
repo=BeamMP/BeamMP-Server
case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) arch=x86_64 ;;
aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
*) echo "BeamMP has no server for $(uname -m)."; exit 1 ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$want" = latest ] || want="v${want#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want") ||
    { echo "BeamMP has no release ${VERSION}. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as v3.9.3."; exit 1; }
# Built for the Debian the server's image runs.
asset="BeamMP-Server.debian.13.$arch"
assets=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag")
if ! awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a { f = 1 } END { exit !f }' <<<"$assets"; then
    asset="BeamMP-Server.debian.12.$arch"
    awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a { f = 1 } END { exit !f }' <<<"$assets" ||
        { echo "BeamMP ${tag#v} has no Linux server for $arch. Choose a newer version."; exit 1; }
fi
sum=$(awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a { print $2 }' <<<"$assets")

if [ -x BeamMP-Server ] && [ "$(sha256sum BeamMP-Server | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "BeamMP ${tag#v} is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading BeamMP ${tag#v} ($asset)"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" BeamMP-Server.new
    chmod +x BeamMP-Server.new
    mv -f BeamMP-Server.new BeamMP-Server
fi
mkdir -p Resources/Client Resources/Server

# The settings the Panel writes at every start need their lines; BeamMP
# adds its other settings itself.
if [ ! -f ServerConfig.toml ]; then
    cat > ServerConfig.toml <<'TOML'
# BeamMP's settings: https://docs.beammp.com/server/server-maintenance/
# Name, Description, Port, AuthKey, MaxPlayers, MaxCars, Map and Private
# come from the server's settings in the Panel.
[General]
Name = "BeamMP Server"
Description = "A BeamMP server"
Port = 30814
AuthKey = ""
Private = true
MaxPlayers = 8
MaxCars = 1
Map = "/levels/gridmap_v2/info.json"
Tags = "Freeroam"
LogChat = true
ResourceFolder = "Resources"
TOML
fi
echo "Installed BeamMP ${tag#v}."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The BeamMP server release to install, such as v3.9.3, or latest.

variables.name: AuthKey
variables.description: Your server's key from BeamMP's Keymaster. The server doesn't start without one.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name shown in the server list.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: The description shown in the server list.

variables.name: Private
variables.description: Keep the server out of the public server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players connected at once.

variables.name: Max cars
variables.description: The most cars each player can spawn.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map's info.json path, such as /levels/west_coast_usa/info.json.
